title: A Ledger for the Will
author: Freya Okonkwo
blurb: Mara Ravensworth, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
